Zwei Ecktaschen mit je zwei Zugängen, ei: Two corner pockets with two entrances each, an ice moon in the middle, a site and a flickering gate. For beginners.
Jede Basis in einer Tasche mit einem Zug: Each base in a pocket with a single entrance, nebula walls in between. Two gates link the backyards.
Langer Korridor, Engstellen aus Asteroid: A long corridor, asteroid chokepoints with an ash cloud in the gap, a site in the middle.
Ein zerbrochener Mond als Trümmerring um: A shattered moon as a debris ring around the great site, corner pockets for the bases, ion nebulae in the rubble.
Ein Kranz aus Ionennebel um die Mitte, v: A crown of ion nebula around the centre with four open gateways. The bases sit in corner pockets with two entrances.
Drei Bahnen zwischen den Basen: kurz dur: Three lanes between the bases: short through ash clouds, central through the chokepoint with the site, long and quiet across the south.

Im Aschenebel: Schilde aus, die Hülle ni: Inside the ash nebula: shields down, the hull takes damage.
Bis zu acht Basen im Ring, jede in einer: Up to eight bases in a ring, each in a pocket with two entrances; nebulae between neighbours, fields and the site in the middle.

WASD/Pfeile verschieben, Rad zoomt, Rech: WASD/arrows pan, wheel zooms, right-click orders, Ctrl+right-click attack-move, H stop, G hold, X explore, 1–5 groups, Shift+digit stores, P pause.
Offene Weite ohne Taschen: die Basen im: Wide open space without pockets: bases in a ring, deposits scattered everywhere, only small fields and patches of nebula. Attacks come from every side.
Jede Basis hinter einem undurchdringlich: Every base behind an impenetrable asteroid belt with a single narrow entrance. A second ring of rock guards the great site in the centre – chokepoints everywhere.
Felswände trennen die Basen voneinander,: Rock walls separate the bases, every route leads through the centre. The richest deposits and the great site lie there – this is where the battle rages.
In der Mitte eine Piratenfestung hinter: A pirate fortress in the centre behind a ring of rock with narrow gates: turrets, flak and a garrison that rebuilds itself. Whoever destroys or boards the core claims the pirate treasure.
Gekrümmte Felswände drehen sich wie ein: Curved rock walls spin out from the centre like a pinwheel. Every base sits at the end of its arm; neighbours are reached through a gap in the wall or via the centre.
Viele kleine Asteroideninseln mit Vorkom: Many small asteroid islands with deposits and ruins, each with three passages. Small ships slip through the belts, large ones have to take the channels.
Ein breiter Ionensturm umschließt die Mi: A wide ion storm surrounds the centre: shields down, short sight only, with nests of ash inside. Whoever crosses flies blind – ambushes are the rule here.
